pressureField: A qualified slow pull request needs one durable, non-preemptive, expiring and fenced delivery turn while final protected-ref authority remains external.
candidateInvariants: authority binds one exact target cut
stale or expired authority fails closed
failureOrCounterexample: The source lacks a portable issuer-holder pair and independent revocation event, so it cannot prove the complete generic KFD-10 lifecycle.

observation.summary: A leased, fenced delivery authority binds one exact candidate, protected base, source and proof roots, generation, expected old state, and expiry.

genericClaims.basis: The warrant binds repository, protected base, candidate, source head, proof roots, generation, and expected-old state root.
Every warrant has issuedAt and expiresAt; mutation rejects an expired lease.
The retained object does not independently identify both issuer and holder.
Expiry recovery and terminal close are explicit, but an independent revocation transition is not present.
Terminal close clears the active warrant and the Git ref retains queue history, but the warrant object has no portable consumed event chain.

profileSpecificClaims.basis: The exact fencing token and lease generation gate Buildchain delivery queue mutations.
The source explicitly leaves final protected-ref authority with GitHub Merge Queue.

promotion.reason: One product implementation is evidence for candidate clauses, not authority to activate or universally define KFD-10.
